en.headline: Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to Wan Chai Harbourfront
en.dek: The three-day event organised by Live Nation Electronic Asia runs through Sunday at the Wan Chai Harbourfront Event Space with 9-metre installations and live music.
body: The Spooky Halloween Music Carnival has returned to the Wan Chai Harbourfront Event Space at 3 Hung Hing Road, according to the Hong Kong Tourism Board.

Organised by Live Nation Electronic Asia, the event runs from 30 October to 1 November. The Carnival Zone is open from noon to 10pm today and tomorrow, while the Mainstage Music Zone operates daily from 6pm to 10.30pm.

The site features 9-metre-tall installations of Attack on Titan and Godzilla, plus a horror maze presented by street culture brand CLOT. Visitors can also use inflatable slides, play carnival games and visit food stalls.
The Tourism Board described the carnival as an immersive festive destination for families, youths and pop-culture fans. Admission prices vary and are listed on the organiser's ticketing page.

zh.headline: Spooky Halloween音樂嘉年華回歸灣仔海濱
zh.dek: 由Live Nation Electronic Asia主辦的三日活動於灣仔海濱活動空間舉行至周日，設有9米高裝置及現場音樂。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，Spooky Halloween音樂嘉年華已重返灣仔鴻興道3號灣仔海濱活動空間。
活動由Live Nation Electronic Asia主辦，於10月30日至11月1日舉行。嘉年華區今日及明日由中午12時開放至晚上10時，主舞台音樂區則每日下午6時至晚上10時30分運作。
場地設有9米高的《進擊的巨人》及哥斯拉裝置，以及潮流品牌CLOT呈獻的驚悚迷宮。現場亦有充氣滑梯、攤位遊戲及特色餐飲。
旅發局形容活動為家庭、青少年及流行文化愛好者的沉浸式節日目的地。入場票價不一，詳情見主辦單位購票頁面。
